flow.title: The daily flow
flow.s1: Orders arrive from the Sllr store, WhatsApp, or Instagram.
flow.s2: Sllr orders: download the export file from Sllr and drop it in the import box — everything is converted automatically.
flow.s3: WhatsApp / Instagram orders: add them with the manual form.
flow.s4: Review the table — any order flagged with ⚠ needs its governorate fixed.
flow.s5: Press “Export Wassalha file” to download the shipping sheet, then upload it to Wassalha.
flow.s6: After shipping, press “Clear all” — the batch moves to the History page (it is not deleted), and the list is empty for the next day.

rules.title: Fixed conversion rules
rules.r1: Weight is always 500 in the export file.
rules.r2: Reference Number is always empty in the export (Wassalha rejects Sllr IDs). The Sllr ID is kept internally for tracking.
rules.r3: Phone numbers are converted to local format (+20… → 0…).
rules.r4: Governorates are converted to Wassalha names (e.g. Sohag → SOUHAGE).
rules.r5: COD equals the order amount for Cash on Delivery, otherwise 0.
